title: Length of the configuration encoding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. The encoded configuration word has length $W(2s+1)+w_P(|x|)+1$, where $W$ is the fixed cell-code width for $N$ and $w_P(n)$ is the length of the binary representation of $n+1$.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine N with k work tapes
configuration C of N on input x
